seen.body: Follow-up to the sub-issue mapping (4.10.0): the first sync after the upgrade sets a parent on every mirrored issue whose parent is mirrored (about 1,800 mutating calls on foundlings). They go through the same create pacing, and a [[mirror]] option sub_issues = false turns the mapping off.
seen.title: Sub-issue calls are paced and can be switched off per mirror
